WITH joined AS (
  SELECT p.throws
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
),
by_throws AS (
  SELECT throws, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY throws
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM by_throws
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws, 
    cnt,
    CAST(cnt AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_sum) as share
  FROM by_throws
),
avg_of_shares AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT throws, cnt, share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_of_shares)
)
SELECT
  SUM(cnt),
  AVG(share),
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_of_shares))
FROM filtered
